headline: Indian Markets Surge as Sensex Reclaims 83,000 and Nifty Tops 25,500 Led by Banks and Auto

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Auto and banking stocks drove a strong market rally, pushing Sensex up nearly 1,000 points.
Foreign Portfolio Investors poured over Rs 1 lakh crore into Indian stocks, supporting market strength.
Newly-listed companies contributed ₹32-trillion to BSE market capitalization in 2026.
Global Asian markets faced sharp sell-offs due to growing concerns around the AI trade.
whatHappening: Nifty reclaimed 25,500 for the first time since February, while Bank Nifty reached a record high.
Asian indices like Nikkei and Kospi crashed 4% following a global AI-related market sell-off.
Indian smallcap stocks in the telecom/tech hardware space faced sell-offs linked to AI anxiety.
Oil prices remained elevated above $92 per barrel despite record Hormuz oil flows and rising Saudi exports.
summary: Indian equity markets rallied strongly led by bank and auto stocks, with Nifty scaling above 25,500 and Sensex reclaiming 83,000. Institutional inflows remain robust with FPIs pouring Rs 1 lakh crore into domestic equities. However, global headwinds from Asian market sell-offs and AI concerns continue to impact selected smallcap stocks.
